expected_motion: Default shot_binary_v1: one expected moving/static decision per entity per whole shot. Explicit legacy runtime profiles retain interval_v2.

within_shot.shots: all supplied shots including singleton scenes
within_shot.spatial_population: both entities classified static over the whole shot; explicit interval_v2 rollback retains interval eligibility
within_shot.presence_trigger: missing retained observation at an expected-static keyframe
within_shot.geometry: original per-frame evidence, regardless of auxiliary fusion outlier flags
within_shot.units: one presence unit per entity; one spatial unit per entity pair per shot

cross_shot.pairs: consecutive occurrences of each scene in manifest order
cross_shot.frames: exact previous final keyframe and next first keyframe
cross_shot.spatial_conflicts: existing independent local-reference/support and prompt-cause gates

spatial.denominator: all enumerated entity pairs, including exempt and unresolved pairs
spatial.counting: each pair at most once per shot or same-scene boundary
spatial.nonnegative_cosine: no_conflict (no anomaly proposal), not unknown solely for lack of review

default_motion_definition.moving: applicable in-shot prompt action or original-frame-grounded natural dynamic
default_motion_definition.static: no supported legitimate motion; unexplained drift must not self-exempt
default_motion_definition.anchor_stability: assessed by original matching criteria, not inferred from binary static
